summary: The Riftspire Reaches are towering dimensional spires formed from condensed Discord energy. They serve as the Riftseekers’ domain, stabilizing rifts and anchoring fractured space across the Riftlands.
history: Riftspires formed when Discord energy condensed into vertical dimensional pillars.
Riftseekers established sanctums atop the spires to stabilize planar fractures.
Skyfracture Terraces emerged as floating platforms orbiting the tallest spires.
The Attunement Nexus became the central hub for rift calibration and planar travel.
Muramite forces attempted to seize the spires but were repelled by Riftseeker wards.
